text:
deploybot: Canary for rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix in eu-west1 triggered failures on embeddings path (503s). Rollout auto-PAUSED. Manual decision required: expedited pin to patched image or rollback. Logs: https://internal.logs/ingest/1719627777 :warning:

elaine: Noted. Is this the same kv-cache regression we debugged in staging yesterday?

mike: Yeah, reproduces on a narrow traffic slice in staging. Seems like an edge OOM when the quantized kernel hits certain keys.

sam: @sre-oncall can you pull last 15m error & latency deltas? Need concrete numbers before we act.

sre-oncall: Pulling. Quick numbers: errors +2.3% service-wide in eu-west1, p95 latency +20ms. Topology shows embed shard-4 spike.

dana: If it's isolated to shard-4 we have options: 1) rollback eu-west1 to stable 2) pin a targeted canary with the micro-patch 3) divert embed traffic off eu-west1. Which is least disruptive?

elaine: Product is seeing fallbacks; we should avoid broad rollback if possible. Proposal: evacuate embed traffic from eu-west1, deploy micro-patch to that shard, then small canary.

mike: I'm on the patch. Plan: disable quant kernel for shard-4 only and rebuild image. ETA ~30m.

sam: If we evacuate traffic we must update support & release note ASAP. I'll prepare a short advisory.

sre-oncall: Executing traffic shift now. Command run: ```
rbctl traffic shift --service=embeddings --from=eu-west1 --to=global-fallback --percentage=100 --confirm
```

deploybot: Action recorded: traffic-shift started by sre-oncall at 2026-03-23T03:21:45Z. Canary paused.

dana: @mike once you push the patch we can do a tiny 5% canary in eu-west1 and observe for 10m. If clean, ramp.

mike: Pushed rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix.2 (micro-patch, shard-4 quant kernel disabled). Requesting manual pin for eu-west1 5%.

elaine: I'll approve the limited pin to 5% for eu-west1 provided we abort on any >0.5% error delta sustained for 10m. @sre-oncall confirm alerting.

sre-oncall: Confirmed. I added a temporary alert: embed-5xx > baseline+0.5% for 10m -> page. Dash: https://dashboards/internal/embeds-eu-west1

sam: Draft advisory: "Deploy: targeted kernel patch for embeddings (shard-4) in eu-west1. We diverted traffic temporarily and are canarying a patched image. No customer action required." Will post and link.

deploybot: Manual pin command logged: ```
deploybot pin --image=rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix.2 --scope=eu-west1 --percentage=5 --reason="shard-4 kernel patch"
```

dana: +1 from ops for 5% canary.

mike: Starting canary now.

sre-oncall: Monitoring live. No new 5xxs in first 6m. Will watch until 30m threshold.

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 12m. No regressions yet. Awaiting full 30m window.

dana: Tagging support & product: @support-team @product for visibility.

elaine: Keep updates short. If alert fires, execute rollback to rbld/inference:20260320-stable.

mike: Update: 30m reached, metrics green. Proceeding to 50% ramp per rollout plan.

sre-oncall: Ramp started via deploybot: 5% -> 50% in eu-west1. Next checkpoint in 15m.

sam: Release note posted: https://confluence.company/hotfix/20260323-embed-shard4-patch (includes rollback rationale and change window).

deploybot: Ramp progressed to 50% successfully. Will continue standard ramp cadence.

dana: Thanks all for quick turnaround. Post-mortem to follow if we confirm root cause.

elaine: Agreed. Short standup after deploy to capture timeline.
